name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for water intrusion repair?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for water intrusion repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for water intrusion repair, consider their experience with similar projects, their licensing and insurance, and their reputation through references or reviews. Ensure they offer a clear, detailed estimate and a warranty for their work. A professional contractor will also explain their diagnostic process and repair plan thoroughly, providing transparency and confidence in their services.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider the contractor's experience, licensing, insurance, reputation, detailed estimates, and warranty. Transparency in their process is also key.
